# crosswork_resource_pools (Data Source)

This data source can read an ID pool of the NSO resource allocator.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crosswork_resource_pools" "example" {
  id   = "cwtest-pool"
  name = "cwtest-pool"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The id of the object
- `name` (String) Pool name, made of letters, digits, underscores, hyphens and dots. A service refers to the pool by this name.

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `range_end` (Number) Last id of the pool, not below the first
- `range_start` (Number) First id of the pool
